implementedFoundation: provider timeout becomes unknown and the original Lease is not automatically retried
automatic reconcile uses provider request id plus request fingerprint and appends a superseding immutable Receipt
only an initial unknown Receipt enters the current reconcile path
compensation is created as a new Proposal referencing the original Receipt rather than mutating history
the Draft Inbox keeps unknown visible and disables automatic reread when provider request id is absent

findings.finding: automatic reconcile stores both provider-applied and provider-failed results under top-level status reconciled; downstream policy cannot safely decide whether the external effect actually happened without parsing an untyped payload.
compensation accepts any reconciled Receipt, including one whose embedded resolvedStatus is failed, so a confirmed non-effect can incorrectly become compensation-eligible.
the caller freely supplies compensation ActionType and payload; no versioned CompensationPolicy maps an exact original outcome to an allowed inverse operation, scope, amount or deadline.

there is no ManualReconcileCase authority with evidence, two-person decision, marking, expiry and immutable decision Receipt; the UI label says manual reread but invokes the automatic Adapter reconcile endpoint.
unknown without providerRequestId is only disabled in the UI and has no canonical handoff to manual investigation, provider support case or fail-closed terminal disposition.
accepted asynchronous outcomes remain executing, while reconcile only permits unknown; no callback or polling authority closes accepted to applied, failed or unknown.

the row lock is released before provider reread, so concurrent requests can both call reconcile; the unique supersedes index protects storage but the service has no durable reconcile attempt or conflict-safe replay protocol.

the new compensation Proposal cites the original Receipt but does not bind the original actionBindingHash, affected object scope, measured applied delta, compensation policy, residual budget or dedicated approval chain.
no canonical exact edge links original Attempt and Receipt, resolved outcome, compensation Proposal, compensation Receipt and residual or partial effect.
